0.original: Uin Nee does not like to be kept waiting, especially when there is frolicking to be done.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Search for the sleepy pixie near Mithai Glorianda.

48.original: Oh dear, dear, dear! At this rate, the children will wake up before we get there!

49.original: It's my friend, you see. We made a promise to go frolicking in Lyhe Mheg, but they're nowhere to be seen! They must've fallen asleep! Can you believe it!?

50.original: Hmph! I'd better stay here on the off chance they come looking for me. What I need is someone to go and find them in my stead... And who else would show up just in time but my favorite mortal! Well then, off you go!

53.original: Not the beavers! Not the beavers! <snore>

54.original: Although you have found the sleeping pixie, they show no signs of waking up any time soon.

55.original: You found them! That's terrific! So...where are they?

56.original: Hmm... Such a deep sleep can only mean one thing. They'll probably be returning to Glorianda any day now.

57.original: What are you looking at me like that for? Must I explain everything? <sigh> Very well.

58.original: You see, even we pixies don't know where we come from. One day we simply awaken─with a poof, or so I like to think! We're alive! And then eventually we lie down to go to sleep and simply fade away...

59.original: Some say we pass into a never-ending dream, where we return to Glorianda, the legendary Forebear of Pixies.

60.original: Or maybe that sleepyhead is just being lazy! Anyway, I've got plenty to keep me busy while I wait for them to wake up, like sending silly mortals running here, there, and everywhere to carry out my bidding! Muahahaha!

61.original: Pixies who sleep for too long sometimes fade away into their dreams, where they return to Glorianda. That silly so-and-so has been going to Mithai Glorianda rather frequently, so maybe their time has come?

62.original: Not that it's any of my concern. I just don't like to be kept waiting! But you'll keep me amused in the meantime, won't you?
